user.title: Heat pump Smart Grid
user.description: Link the two SG-Ready contacts and the measurements: the form suggests the entities recognised by name. On first install the integration starts in «observation»: it decides and writes why in the «Requested stage» sensor, but does not touch the contacts until you pick «automatic» in the «Mode» select.

contatti.name: SG contacts
contatti.description: Contact 1 = switch-on recommendation (IN11 on Ecodan). Contacts 1 and 2 together = switch-on command (IN12). Contact 2 alone blocks the machine: the integration never requests it and closes contact 2 only after seeing contact 1 closed.

data_description.correggi_blocco: If contact 2 is found closed alone it is reopened after a few seconds, whoever closed it, and reported.

rete.name: Grid
rete.description: The grid exchange from the meter: it tells how much is exported.

data_description.segno_rete: Suggested from Nexus Fotovoltaico when it reads the same exchange.

pompa.name: Heat pump
pompa.description: Used to compute the surplus including the heat pump's own draw (so the stage does not drop when the pump starts) and to hold the stage until the cycle ends.

data.acs_massima: Only activate with the tank below

data_description.potenza_pdc: Optional, from a clamp or a meter. Without it, the estimated power is used while the compressor runs.
data_description.potenza_stimata: How much the heat pump draws while running, when there is no measurement.
data_description.acs_massima: Avoids small top-ups: with the tank above this temperature stage 1 is not activated. Needs the tank temperature.

stadi.name: Stages
stadi.description: Thresholds apply to the gross surplus: grid export plus the heat pump power.

data_description.isteresi: A stage is released when the surplus drops below its threshold minus this value.
data_description.stadio_2: Also closes contact 2. On Ecodan it heats hot water to the tank maximum, possibly with the electric heater.

tempi.name: Timing and time window
tempi.description: Outside the window nothing is activated and the stage is released. Delays avoid chasing clouds; minimum duration and pause avoid short heat pump cycles.

data_description.tenuta_ciclo: While the heat pump is heating, the stage is not released until it stops: mid-cycle the machine would stop with the water already above the normal target.
data_description.tenuta_massima: After this time the hold ends even if the heat pump is still running.

error.mancano_obbligatorie: Contact 1 and the grid exchange are required.
error.entita_ripetuta: The same entity is chosen for two different fields.
error.soglie_invertite: The stage 2 surplus must be higher than the stage 1 surplus.
error.fascia_vuota: Window start and end are the same.
error.manca_pompa: Link at least the compressor or the heat pump power: without them the surplus would be net only, and the pump starting would release the stage by itself.
error.contatto_in_uso: This contact is already driven by another Nexus SG Ready entry.
error.contatto_chiuso: You are removing or changing a contact that is closed right now: the reloaded entry would no longer see it. Open it first (with the «off» mode if this integration drives it, otherwise from the system that drives it), then try again.

init.title: Contacts, measurements, thresholds and timing
init.description: Change contacts, measurements, thresholds and timing. Rename the entry to change its name.
